cards.ex: The space race between the US and the Soviet Union pushed technological boundaries.
cards.exUz: AQSh va Sovet Ittifoqi o'rtasidagi kosmik poyga texnologik chegaralarni surdi.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasida kosmosni o'rganishda ustunlik qilish uchun raqobat.

cards.ex: The rocket is scheduled to blast off at dawn.
cards.exUz: Raketa ertalab soat oltida uchishi rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Raketa yoki kosmik kemaning joyidan ko'tarilib, uchishni boshlashi.

cards.ex: Astronauts train to live in zero gravity.
cards.exUz: Astronavtlar nol tortishishda yashashga o'rganadilar.
cards.uzDef: Og'irlikning yo'qligi yoki juda kamligi holati.

cards.ex: Life on the space station is strictly regimented.
cards.exUz: Kosmik stansiyadagi hayot qat'iy tartibga solingan.
cards.uzDef: Kosmosda aylanib yuradigan, odamlar yashashi va tadqiqot o'tkazishi mumkin bo'lgan inshoot.

cards.ex: She was the first woman to walk in space.
cards.exUz: U kosmosda sayr qilgan birinchi ayol edi.
cards.uzDef: Astronavtning kosmik kemadan tashqariga chiqib, kosmosda harakatlanishi.

cards.ex: Scientists are eager to find life on the red planet.
cards.exUz: Olimlar Qizil sayyorada hayot topishga intilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qizil rangga ega bo'lganligi sababli Mars sayyorasiga berilgan nom.

cards.ex: The star is several light years away.
cards.exUz: Yulduz bir necha yorug'lik yili uzoqlikda joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Yorug'lik bir yilda bosib o'tadigan masofa.

cards.ex: Nothing, not even light, can escape a black hole.
cards.exUz: Hech narsa, hatto yorug'lik ham qora tuynukdan qochib qutula olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli tortishish kuchiga ega bo'lgan kosmik hudud.

cards.ex: The possibility of life in outer space fascinates many.
cards.exUz: Tashqi kosmosda hayot bo'lishi mumkinligi ko'pchilikni qiziqtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Yer atmosferasidan tashqaridagi koinotning cheksiz bo'shliqlari.

cards.ex: It's not rocket science, just common sense!
cards.exUz: Bu raketa ilmi emas, shunchaki oddiy aql!
cards.uzDef: Juda murakkab va tushunish qiyin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The countdown to the launch began.
cards.exUz: Uchirish uchun teskari hisob boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa boshlanishidan oldin qilingan teskari sanash.

cards.ex: Our solar system is just one of billions in the galaxy.
cards.exUz: Bizning quyosh sistemamiz galaktikadagi milliardlablardan biri xolos.
cards.uzDef: Quyosh va uning atrofida aylanadigan sayyoralar, asteroidlar va boshqa jismlar.

cards.ex: I really look up to astronauts; they're so brave.
cards.exUz: Men astronavtlarga juda hurmat bilan qarayman; ular juda jasur.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qoyil qoldirib, ularni namuna sifatida ko'rish.

cards.ex: We need to install a satellite dish to get better TV reception.
cards.exUz: Biz yaxshiroq teleko'rsatuv qabul qilish uchun sun'iy yo'ldosh antenna o'rnatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sun'iy yo'ldoshlardan signal qabul qiluvchi parabolik antenna.

cards.ex: Scientists are trying to figure out how the universe began.
cards.exUz: Olimlar koinot qanday boshlanganini aniqlashga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish yoki yechim topish.

cards.ex: We spent the evening star gazing with a telescope.
cards.exUz: Biz kechqurun teleskop bilan yulduzlarga qarab zavqlandik.
cards.uzDef: Kechasi yulduzlarga qarab zavqlanish.

cards.ex: Many asteroids in the asteroid belt are quite large.
cards.exUz: Asteroidlar kamaridagi ko'plab asteroidlar juda katta.
cards.uzDef: Mars va Yupiter o'rtasidagi asteroidlardan tashkil topgan hudud.

cards.ex: The spacecraft will fly by Jupiter and take pictures.
cards.exUz: Kosmik kema Yupiterning yonidan uchib o'tib, suratga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Tezlik bilan biror joyning yonidan uchib o'tish.

cards.ex: The man on the moon was a huge achievement for humanity.
cards.exUz: Oydagi odam insoniyat uchun ulkan yutuq edi.
cards.uzDef: Odamzodning Oyga qo'nganligi haqidagi hodisa.

cards.ex: Mission control gave the astronauts the go-ahead.
cards.exUz: Missiya markazi astronavtlarga ruxsat berdi.
cards.uzDef: Kosmik parvozlarni nazorat qiluvchi markaz.

cards.ex: Space debris is becoming a serious problem.
cards.exUz: Kosmik chiqindi jiddiy muammoga aylanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kosmosda aylanib yuradigan sun'iy narsalarning qoldiqlari.

cards.ex: The probe sent back amazing images of Saturn's rings.
cards.exUz: Zond Saturn halqalarining ajoyib tasvirlarini yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Sayyoralar va kosmosni o'rganish uchun yuborilgan avtomatik qurilma.

cards.ex: Always reach for the stars, even if you don't quite get there.
cards.exUz: Doim yulduzlarga intiling, hatto unga to'liq erisha olmasangiz ham.
cards.uzDef: Katta orzularga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The rocket was prepared on the launch pad.
cards.exUz: Raketa uchirish maydonida tayyorlandi.
cards.uzDef: Raketalar uchiriladigan maxsus joy.

cards.ex: Cosmic dust can obscure our view of distant galaxies.
cards.exUz: Kosmik chang uzoq galaktikalarni ko'rishimizga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kosmosdagi mayda chang va gaz zarralari.

cards.ex: I'd jump at the chance to go to space!
cards.exUz: Men kosmosga borish imkoniyatini qo'ldan bermas edim!
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilish imkoniyati paydo bo'lganda, darhol rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: Space junk poses a threat to satellites and spacecraft.
cards.exUz: Kosmik axlat sun'iy yo'ldoshlar va kosmik kemalar uchun xavf tug'diradi.
cards.uzDef: Kosmosda aylanib yurgan keraksiz narsalar qoldiqlari.

cards.ex: The view from the spaceship was out of this world.
cards.exUz: Kosmik kemadan ko'rinish juda ajoyib edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ajoyib, hayratlanarli, tasavvurga sig'mas.

cards.ex: Space exploration is all about pushing the envelope of what's possible.
cards.exUz: Kosmik tadqiqotlar imkoniyatlar chegarasini kengaytirish haqida.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada imkoniyatlarni chegarasidan o'tkazish.

cards.ex: Maybe one day we'll settle down on Mars.
cards.exUz: Balki bir kun kelib biz Marsda joylasharmiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda yashashni boshlash.
